advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Remove the `import-linter (no module-scope heavy imports)` required-status-check context from `infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json`, since the `import-linter` job was deleted from `_optionality.yml`.
evidence: Removed signature (diff, .github/workflows/_optionality.yml): `-  import-linter:` / `-    name: import-linter (no module-scope heavy imports)`
infra/github/rollback-mirror-lock.sh:9-10: `Recreates the original `main-protection` ruleset by POSTing the snapshot at infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json`
advisory.finding: The `import-linter (no module-scope heavy imports)` job removed from `_optionality.yml` is still named as a required status-check `context` in `infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json`; that snapshot is the rollback source POSTed by `infra/github/rollback-mirror-lock.sh` to recreate the `main-protection` ruleset, so the deleted check name survives as a dangling required-check reference.
scenarios: mirror-lock rollback runs `rollback-mirror-lock.sh`, recreating `main-protection` from the snapshot with a required check the deleted job no longer emits — the check stays pending forever and blocks all merges to main
advisory.suggested_fix: Delete the `{"context":"import-linter (no module-scope heavy imports)"}` entry from the `required_status_checks` array in `infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json` so the rollback snapshot no longer demands a check that no workflow emits.
